description: This file defines and exports a plugin entry for the Synology Chat channel in an OpenClaw plugin system. It imports core functions and two specific modules, re-exports the modules, and constructs a plugin entry object with metadata.

methods.name: defineChannelPluginEntry
methods.description: Function to define a plugin entry for a channel in the OpenClaw plugin framework.

calls: defineChannelPluginEntry({ id: 'synology-chat', name: 'Synology Chat', description: 'Native Synology Chat channel plugin for OpenClaw', plugin: synologyChatPlugin, setRuntime: setSynologyRuntime })
